us: Navy helicopter disables M/T Vela Nova
effects: Two Hellfires · ~71nm off Pakistani coast · Third vessel disabled
iran: Houthis kill six on tanker Tihamah in Bab el-Mandeb
tldr: A Navy helicopter fired two Hellfire missiles into the Vela Nova some 71 nautical miles off the Pakistani coast — the third vessel forcibly disabled under the blockade, and proof that enforcement stayed lethal while talks stayed stalled. The same day, Houthi missiles killed six aboard the Tanzanian-flagged Tihamah in the Bab el-Mandeb, the first fatal shipping attack there in over a year.
